proposal.expected_benefit: This will ensure full alignment between audit and compliance controls, prevent ambiguity in control implementation, and eliminate potential control failures due to conflicting requirements.
proposal.problem: The contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions remains unresolved, which could lead to potential control failures.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a formalized audit-compliance alignment protocol that explicitly defines the precedence and interdependencies between audit and compliance controls. This protocol should include automated checks to ensure that compliance decisions do not override audit requirements and that audit status is a mandatory prerequisite for any compliance-related action.
proposal.title: Clarify and Enforce Audit and Compliance Alignment
verification_tests: Verify that audit status is a mandatory prerequisite for compliance decisions.
Validate that compliance gates enforce audit-before-execution rules.
Confirm that audit-compliance alignment checks are triggered during all compliance-related actions.
